caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate sofa positioned in the center of the composition against a plain, beige background. The sofa has a carved wooden frame with a dark brown color and features elaborate detailing along the crest rail, arms, and lower edge. The upholstery is a patterned, textured fabric in shades of light tan and gold, adorned with a diamond-shaped tufted design along the backrest and armrests. The seat cushion and sides of the sofa display a subtle, intricate floral pattern in similar tan and light green hues. The legs of the sofa are curved, with front cabriole legs and decorative carvings. No other objects or elements are present in the image; the focus remains solely on the sofa.
title: Settee - Sofa
